clips.title: The story
paras: Following the Sigil of Arathor, Zengu sends you to slay Prince Galen Trollbane and take the last sigil, the one that unlocks his father Thoras Trollbane's tomb. The prince keeps it on his own person, far inside Stromgarde.

The last sigil that can open the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is kept by Thoras's son, Prince Galen, in person. He is to be found far inside Stromgarde, in a chapel within the districts the militia holds. Zengu warns that Galen is well guarded and a fine fighter, so this could prove very hard. You are to kill him and carry the sigil to Zengu in Hammerfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've returned, friend. Is the line of Ignaeus Trollbane broken?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Quite a day this is, adventurer. The blood of Trollbane will no longer haunt my people, and the sigils needed to take Trol'kalar are in our possession. Soon, very soon, we will strike against the hated trolls of Zul'Gurub.
